name: Sérine
notes: Local Côte-Rôtie selection and naming vocabulary attached to Syrah. It is not a separate grape identity and not a universal synonym.

name: Crozes-Ermitage
notes: The INAO denomination carries both authorised spellings; they name one appellation.

name: Ermitage
notes: One of four authorised spellings — Hermitage, Ermitage, l'Hermitage, l'Ermitage — for a single appellation.
